name: Sftp.exe
description: sftp.exe is a Windows command-line utility that uses the Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) to securely transfer files between a local machine and a remote server.
author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

commands.description: Spawns ssh.exe which in turn spawns the specified command line. See also this project's entry for ssh.exe.
commands.usecase: Proxy execution of specified command, can be used as a defensive evasion.

detection: sftp.exe executions with ProxyCommand on the command line
sftp.exe spawning ssh.exe with ProxyCommand on the command line
